scenario: A precision on an integer type rejects with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_FORMAT per LGRA.2.9.6.5. Pin: `{t.v:.2d}` on an Int slot parses under LGRA.2.9.6.1's grammar (`dsc.strlit.lgra_2_9_6_1_format`) and is refused by the precision-on-`d` rule in `dsc.validate.lgra_2_9_6_5_refusals` -- not by the grammar, which an earlier `.2_d` reached instead.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info "v: {t.v:.2d}"
